svg.text: Scan Cancellation & Per-Check Error Isolation Sequence
Fault-Tolerant Plugin Execution and Cooperative threading.Event Cancellation Preserving Partial Results
Catch exception, log structured error, record warning
SSE data non-fatal warning badge (scan continues)
Commit enriched findings from Check B
Lookup threading.Event for scan_id and call cancel_event.set()
Poll cancel_event.is_set() before next probe or check
Halt active probing and preserve committed findings
Recompute partial risk_score from committed findings
